description: Capture build (and optionally test) status at migration start; refuse to land conflict resolutions or per-domain applies when the build has broken since baseline; allow --force only with a required --note that is logged in analytics.

requirements.description: Cartographer must capture the build (and optionally test) status at migration start as a baseline (AC-BUILD-BASELINE). Before landing any conflict resolution or per-domain apply, cartographer must verify the current build status against the baseline (AC-BUILD-GUARD) and refuse to proceed if the build has broken since baseline. The --force flag is permitted only when accompanied by a required --note argument; the note must be logged in analytics (AC-BUILD-FORCE-NOTE). Build state must be cached by content hash to avoid redundant rebuilds (AC-BUILD-CACHE).
requirements.title: Build-Green Baseline Guardrail for Safe Migration

validation.notes: AC-BUILD-BASELINE: Baseline capture records build status (pass/fail), timestamp, and content hash of the repository state
AC-BUILD-GUARD: Apply command invoked after a build failure since baseline returns an error referencing the baseline comparison
AC-BUILD-FORCE-NOTE: --force without --note returns an error listing the requirement for a note
AC-BUILD-FORCE-NOTE: --force with --note proceeds and persists the note in the analytics events table
AC-BUILD-CACHE: Second apply with the same content hash reuses cached build status and does not invoke the build toolchain
End-to-end: break a fixture scenario's build → run arch-cart apply → command refuses and prints baseline diff
End-to-end: arch-cart apply --force --note 'deliberate override' on a broken build proceeds and the note appears in arch-cart history
Build cache invalidation: modify a source file → content hash changes → build is re-invoked
No conflict resolution or migration can silently land on a broken build without an explicit human-acknowledged override
The --force note provides an audit trail for post-incident review of broken-build overrides

title: Build-Green Baseline Guardrail
